summary: Applied a full color system refresh to PortalSifast using the provided design palette. Changes: (1) Replaced oklch TailAdmin blue theme with the new palette in app.css — primary #0070d1 (PS Network blue), background #f5f7fa (surface-card), card #ffffff, foreground #121314 (ink-deep), destructive #c81b3a (warning); (2) Sidebar changed from dark navy to true charcoal #1f2024 in light mode; (3) Dark mode now uses true black #000000 background, #121314 card, #181818 popover (canvas-dark / surface-dark-elevated / surface-dark-card); (4) Added extended palette colors to @theme as Tailwind utilities (bg-commerce, text-ink-deep, bg-surface-card, bg-marathon-yellow, text-ps-gold, etc.); (5) Updated progress bar color from #4361ee to #0070d1; (6) Updated card hover shadow and scrollbar to match neutral palette. Build succeeded in 33.76s.
current_status: PortalSifast now uses the new design palette with PS Network blue as primary, charcoal sidebar, clean white cards on light blue-gray background, and true black dark mode. All prior features (Web Official modules, responsive optimizations, API endpoints) remain intact.
